Tableo is a final project at Syntax Institut. Orders and payments in the app are not binding, and no real money is charged.
We are neither willing nor obliged to take part in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board.
The person named in the legal notice is responsible for data processing.

For an account, we store your email address, name and, if you like, a profile photo. For orders, we store the restaurant, items, order type, table number or pickup time, delivery address and the chosen payment method. Guests without an account are signed in anonymously, and we don\'t store any personal data for them.

We only use your location if you allow it: to find your delivery address and, when you\'re out as a driver, so customers can see their delivery live on the map. The driver\'s location is only sent during a route.
For staff, we also store the restaurant, role, join date and whether they\'re currently on duty. This information is visible to the team of the respective restaurant.

The app uses Google Firebase (sign-in, database, file storage) and Google Maps or Apple Maps for the map view. Exchange rates come from frankfurter.app, and no personal data is transferred. Data may also be processed on servers outside the EU.
On your phone, we only store settings like appearance, language and whether the onboarding has already been shown.
Notifications about your orders are created by the app itself on your device. No data is sent to a push service for this.

You can delete your account anytime under Account → Delete account. It will then be scheduled for 30 days and afterwards deleted along with team access and profile photo. Orders remain with the restaurant for accounting purposes.

You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection. To exercise them, use the contact details in the legal notice. You can also file a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.
These terms apply to the use of the Tableo app, which lets you order from participating restaurants at the table, for pickup or for delivery.
Orders go directly to the respective restaurant. Tableo only facilitates the order and is not the seller of the food and drinks.

By placing an order, the customer makes an offer to the restaurant. The restaurant can accept or cancel the order as long as it isn\'t on its way yet. The customer can cancel as long as the restaurant hasn\'t accepted it yet.
The prices shown in the app apply, including VAT. The chosen payment method is saved with the order; payment is made at the restaurant or to the driver.
Displayed arrival times are estimates. We accept no liability for delays caused by traffic or high demand.
Login details must be kept confidential. Staff accounts may only be used for your own restaurant. Accounts that violate these terms may be suspended.
The respective restaurant is responsible for the content and quality of the food. Tableo is only liable in cases of intent and gross negligence.
German law applies. If any provision is invalid, the remaining provisions remain in effect.
